messages:
Nina (Sales): Handing off SilverStream. Mid-market, signed 2024-07-10, 12mo. Onboarding ~55%. Two blockers: SSO failing (Okta cert) and bulk CSV ingest errors. Renewal flagged as medium risk if not stable by next month.

Priya (CS): I'll own onboarding and enablement. Need contacts, logs, and can we do a 30m enablement Wed 10am PT? Also they want cost controls overview.

Nina (Sales): Contacts: sam@silverstream.io (Platform Lead), leah@silverstream.io (PM). Sam ok to upload metadata and a sanitized CSV to shared drive. Intro email sent.

Theo (Eng): Reproduced Okta cert error: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority". Opening ENG-9001. Likely config change + restart on dedicated host. Need IdP metadata XML.

Marco (Support): Creating SUPPORT-4007 and adding a synthetic monitor for ingest endpoints. Alert: page oncall if 5xx >1% over 5m.

Priya (CS): Owners & next steps: Priya = onboarding + enablement (Wed 10am PT); Theo = ENG-9001, apply config, coordinate restart; Marco = SUPPORT-4007 + monitors; Nina = customer liaison and confirm uploads. I'll create CS-1300 epic and link tickets.

Nina (Sales): Sam confirmed Tuesday 15:00-16:00 PT maintenance window and will upload files. I'll update CRM with "monitoring" renewal flag and follow up in 30 days on adoption metrics.

Theo (Eng): I can do restart Tue 15:10 PT post pre-call. Will post PR & health checks to ENG-9001.

Priya (CS): Thanks team — prepping calendar invites and feedback doc for enablement. Use this thread for quick status updates.
